ops.title: project: IN-FLIGHT wave — cc-transcript full parser swap tree-sitter-bash → rable (Phase A2), then captain-hook Phase B rm-guard consumption; worktrees/oracle/gate locations + the exact contract + remaining sequence

ops.body:
**In-flight wave (2026-07-20).** Grew from a captain-hook ask ("nested payload rm→trash rewrite + structural `Command` + evaluate the regexes") into a **cc-transcript full shell-parser swap**. User made the calls via AskUserQuestion: (1) upstream tainted-payload handling in cc-transcript, not a captain-hook hack; (2) **full parser swap to `rable`** (0.2.1, MIT) over augment-tree-sitter, *accepting* the tradeoffs — rable spans are **char indices** (need a char→byte shim; `Word.PartialEq` includes span so it must be byte-exact) and it's a bus-factor-1 dep — to enumerate tainted payloads structurally + delete the heredoc-recovery cluster. Byte-offset gate FAILED for every swap candidate (rable/brush char-indexed; yash-syntax/flash/mystsh GPL; cv/bash-ast GPL+FFI+no-spans); only tree-sitter passes — user chose rable anyway.

**Why the swap is feasible (spike-proven, `/tmp/rable-spike/`):** rable is a Rust crate inside cc-transcript's own `rust/crates/core` (its sexp-only Python binding is irrelevant — cc-transcript has its OWN PyO3 layer). char→byte map is a 5-liner (verified on `rm café.txt` → bytes 3..12). Taint = any `Word.parts` is an expansion kind. `$()`/backtick auto-reparse (depth-2 cap vs current 3). Native multi-heredoc → **deletes the ~140-line heredoc-recovery cluster**. rable does NOT dequote or expose quote-layer/`expandable` → reuse cc-transcript's existing `dequote` + re-scan the raw word slice's leading quote.

**State / locations (REBASED v14.6.1 → v14.7.0 on 2026-07-20):** a concurrent push moved cc-transcript main to **v14.7.0** (`3d7abb9`, tagged + on PyPI): +240 lines in `command.rs` adding `Command.split_options` (over words) + **arity-aware, six-bypass-hardened wrapper unwrap** (both in the KEEP-machinery — the parser swap sits on top). The port rebased onto v14.7.0.
- Isolated cc-transcript worktree: **`/private/tmp/cct-rable-147` @ v14.7.0** (origin/main `3d7abb9`). (Stale v14.6.1 worktree `/private/tmp/cct-rable` — remove.) ⚠️ WORKING COPY `/Users/yasyf/Code/cc-transcript` is v14.2.0 — edit the worktree, not it.
- Differential oracle: **`/tmp/cct_golden.json`** (117 lines, dumped from released **14.7.0** via `/tmp/cct147venv`, incl. wrapper-arity cases) + gate **`/tmp/cct_diff.py`** (0 REGRESSIONS required; 7 INTENDED tainted `-c`/`eval` lines may change — they gain the inner enumerated occurrence). Regenerate the oracle from the SAME cc-transcript the port targets.
- Port lane: agent `cct-rable-port` (opus) rewriting `rust/crates/core/src/command.rs` (1926 lines).
- `tree-sitter`/`tree-sitter-bash` are **feature-gated** behind the optional `command` feature → clean swap (`command = ["dep:rable"]`). Core stays edition 2021 (rable edition-2024 is internal; rustc 1.97.1). Keep parser-agnostic machinery: `dequote`/`splice`/`embeddable`/`quote_for`/`prefix`/`runs`/wrapper-strip/PyO3.

**The one intended change:** tainted payload (`bash -c "rm $F"`, double-quoted-with-expansion) currently bails (`command.rs:1024`, value=None) → 1 occurrence; NEW = dequote raw + re-parse via rable → inner `rm` enumerated as a **span-less (span=None → splice refuses = non-rewritable), nesting+1** occurrence. Clean single-quoted payloads already enumerate — keep identical.

**Remaining sequence:** A2 port → differential green → **release cc-transcript 14.7.0 (CONFIRM with user before push)** → Phase B captain-hook: delete ALL manual descent (`descend_rm`/`nested_command_string`/`SHELL_C_FLAG`) + obsolete regex helpers (`SAFE_WORD`/`unescape_shell`/`emit_token`/`plain_words`/`normalize_executable`); uniform occurrence-based rm-guard (clean nested → trash-rewrite via occurrence splice; tainted span-less → block-only); walker scope-aware cwd.

**A2 port status (2026-07-20):** rewrite DONE by agent `cct-rable-port` on `/private/tmp/cct-rable` (rebased v14.6.1→v14.7.0 by me via `git rebase --onto 3d7abb9 8bf374a`; only the `use literals::command::{}` import conflicted — dropped dead `COMPOUND_OPS`, kept v14.7.0 `WRAPPER_OPERAND_SKIP`/`WRAPPER_VALUE_FLAGS`). 377 cargo tests pass; wheel builds. Adversarial review (`cct-port-review`) found: **1 CRITICAL** — redirect-straddling command span (`min..max` over words spans across a redirect when a word follows it → `splice` clobbers the redirect, e.g. `echo a >out b`, security-rewrite path; fix = span None when words straddle a redirect, matching base's safe-refuse); **1 minor** — ANSI-C `$'…'`/locale `$"…"` decode wrong + lose taint (base returned None); plus 2 exotic minors (skip). 3 divergences (rable more-correct): `a & b` (`&`→null, FIX to match), `time cmd` (reserved word→real command, KEEP+changelog, security-positive), `cmd &>out` (correct span, KEEP). Verified non-issues: char→byte on mid-line multibyte, heredocs, `|&`, deep `$()`, compound taint. Fix set dispatched to `cct-rable-port`. char→byte via `Src` map; rable gotchas: part spans always (0,0), no dequote, spans char-indexed, assignments leading-only, standalone `$()` excluded from words. Differential gate `/tmp/cct_diff.py` INTENDED now = 7 tainted + `time cmd` + `cmd &>out`.

**A2 RELEASED as cc-transcript 14.8.0** (2026-07-20, user-approved): squashed feat commit `a3c57df` + `chore(release): stamp 14.8.0` (CHANGELOG), rebased onto live main (`8efe552`), re-authored to Yasyf, pushed `8efe552..5d35022 → main`, tag `v14.8.0` pushed → release-pypi.yml. (GitHub API had a 503 outage delaying run-status confirmation; PyPI poll `b0740kimw` confirms publish.) Fixes 379 cargo tests + 0 diff-regressions verified on `/private/tmp/cct-rable`.

**Phase B RE-SCOPED (concurrent capt-hook work):** capt-hook main advanced ~20 commits past my `ch-wave-wt` base `b28312b5` → now `4e1ed257`, including `51596e25 feat(cmd): fluent evt.cmd command-walk API`, `b65dfe88 refactor(deletions): rewrite the rm guard onto evt.cmd`, `0c9f5d9e reconcile to canonical 14.7 Word/payload`, `59d60bfd require cc-transcript 14.7`, `465c2ebf feat! packs two-provider redesign`. So the rm-guard is ALREADY rewritten onto a fluent `evt.cmd` API, but pinned to **14.7 (no tainted enum)**. My `ch-wave-wt` B2 (dual-mode Command) is uncommitted + stale. Recon `chook-main-recon` determining what's LEFT: bump pin to 14.8 + make the rewritten rm-guard consume tainted enumeration + reconcile/re-do B2. Old plan's B3/B4 largely superseded.

**PHASE B DONE + on branch `phase-b-14.8`** (commit `97bfefb3`, 2026-07-20; worktree `/tmp/chook-phaseb` off capt-hook main `4e1ed257`): (1) pin `>=14.7`→`>=14.8`; (2) two tainted rm-guard inline tests (`bash -c "rm $F"` / `eval "rm $F"` → Block) — VERIFIED passing on local 14.8 (18 inline tests, 0 fail; `bash -c "rm $F"` now DENIES); (3) B4 — `builtin_packs/fixes/hooks/_lib.py` `is_dangerous_command` drops the manual `nested_command_string` descent (redundant with `cl.commands` enumeration on 14.1+; **0 behavior diff** over a 22-line corpus incl. deep nesting + tainted + substitutions), thinned imports, updated stale tree-sitter docstring. **LANDING BLOCKED (not pushed to main):** (a) PyPI 14.8.0 not published — cc-transcript release stuck QUEUED on a GitHub Actions outage (the `>=14.8` pin won't resolve in CI until it publishes); (b) capt-hook main carries a **pre-existing broken test** `tests/test_pack_deletions.py` (imports `rm_targets`, which the concurrent guard-rewrite `b65dfe88` removed without updating the test — NOT my change). Merge `phase-b-14.8` → main once both clear.

Local 14.8 dev env: wheel `/tmp/cctw/cc_transcript-14.7.0-...whl` (14.8 CODE, mislabeled 14.7.0 — maturin stamps from pyproject not the tag); installed into `/tmp/chook-phaseb/.venv`. Verify env: `python -c "import cc_transcript.command as C; print(C.parse_command_line('bash -c \"rm \$F\"').occurrences[1].command.span)"` → None. **Never `uv run` in that worktree** (re-syncs → clobbers the 14.8 wheel back to PyPI 14.7).

**DEFERRED (clean follow-up):** `util/shell.py` dead-helper removal — `SAFE_WORD`/`SHELL_C_FLAG`/`NESTED_COMMAND_DEPTH`/`emit_token`/`nested_command_string` are now dead (no production consumers after B4; only shell.py-internal + a few tests). Removing them needs test surgery: `test_util_shell.py` (nested_command_string test), `test_pack_deletions.py` (`TestEmitTarget` for emit_token + a NESTED_COMMAND_DEPTH comment). `unescape_shell`/`normalize_executable`/`plain_words`/`resolve_cd`/`SHELLS`/`safe_parse_command_line` STAY (used by `primitives/commands.py` + `_lib.py`). This answers the user's "evaluate whether we need those regexes" = they're now redundant.

**Old captain-hook progress (worktree `.claude/worktrees/ch-wave-wt`, pin already `>=14.6.1`):** B2 dual-mode `Command` (structural vs regex, `nesting==0` pin) DONE + green; `executable_name` landed in `util/shell.py`. B3/B4/B5 pending A2. Golden rm-guard baseline: `/tmp/rm_baseline_before.txt` (intended change: `sudo bash -c 'rm /foo.txt'` deny→trash-rewrite). Related: [[cct-payload-word-primitives-shipped]] [[cctranscript-1460-command-primitives-shipped]] [[rm-trash-rewrite-shipped]].

**Lane note:** codex/`codex-ask` UNAVAILABLE this session (not just usage-limited) → all lanes on Claude (opus/fable).
